cards.back: The money used in Indonesia. We write it as Rp.
cards.say: Rupiah. The money used in Indonesia. We write it as R P.

cards.front: Total
cards.back: The amount you get when you add all the money together.
cards.say: Total. The amount you get when you add all the money together.

cards.front: Change
cards.back: The money you get back when you pay more than the price.
cards.say: Change. The money you get back when you pay more than the price.
Five hundred rupiah plus two hundred rupiah plus two hundred rupiah plus one hundred rupiah equals one thousand rupiah.

figure.alt: Coins worth five hundred, two hundred twice and one hundred rupiah.

cards.say: One thousand rupiah plus five hundred rupiah equals one thousand five hundred rupiah.
Two thousand rupiah plus five hundred rupiah plus five hundred rupiah equals three thousand rupiah.
Five thousand rupiah plus two thousand rupiah plus one thousand rupiah equals eight thousand rupiah.

figure.alt: Notes worth five thousand, two thousand and one thousand rupiah.

cards.say: Ten thousand rupiah plus five thousand rupiah equals fifteen thousand rupiah.
Ten thousand rupiah plus ten thousand rupiah equals twenty thousand rupiah.
Twenty thousand rupiah plus five thousand rupiah plus two thousand rupiah equals twenty-seven thousand rupiah.
Fifty thousand rupiah plus fifty thousand rupiah equals one hundred thousand rupiah.

cards.front: How many Rp200 coins make Rp1.000?
cards.say: How many two hundred rupiah coins make one thousand rupiah? Five coins. Five times two hundred equals one thousand.

cards.front: How many Rp5.000 notes make Rp20.000?
cards.say: How many five thousand rupiah notes make twenty thousand rupiah? Four notes. Four times five thousand equals twenty thousand.

cards.front: How many Rp1.000 notes make Rp10.000?
cards.say: How many one thousand rupiah notes make ten thousand rupiah? Ten notes.

cards.front: A pen costs Rp3.000. You pay Rp5.000. Change?
cards.say: A pen costs three thousand rupiah. You pay five thousand rupiah. What is your change? Two thousand rupiah. Five thousand take away three thousand is two thousand.

cards.front: A ruler costs Rp4.000. You pay Rp10.000. Change?
cards.say: A ruler costs four thousand rupiah. You pay ten thousand rupiah. What is your change? Six thousand rupiah.

cards.front: A cake costs Rp7.000. You pay Rp10.000. Change?
cards.say: A cake costs seven thousand rupiah. You pay ten thousand rupiah. What is your change? Three thousand rupiah.

cards.front: A book costs Rp12.000. You pay Rp20.000. Change?
cards.say: A book costs twelve thousand rupiah. You pay twenty thousand rupiah. What is your change? Eight thousand rupiah.

cards.front: A pencil costs Rp2.000. How much for 3 pencils?
cards.say: A pencil costs two thousand rupiah. How much for three pencils? Six thousand rupiah. Three times two thousand equals six thousand.

cards.front: A sweet costs Rp500. How much for 4 sweets?
cards.say: A sweet costs five hundred rupiah. How much for four sweets? Two thousand rupiah. Four times five hundred equals two thousand.

cards.front: An apple costs Rp3.000 and a banana costs Rp2.000. Total?
cards.say: An apple costs three thousand rupiah and a banana costs two thousand rupiah. What is the total? Five thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Which is more: Rp5.000 or 4 coins of Rp1.000?
cards.back: Rp5.000. 4 coins of Rp1.000 make Rp4.000.
cards.say: Which is more: five thousand rupiah or four coins of one thousand rupiah? Five thousand rupiah. Four coins of one thousand rupiah make four thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Can you buy a Rp8.000 toy with Rp5.000 and Rp2.000?
cards.back: No. Rp5.000 + Rp2.000 = Rp7.000, which is Rp1.000 short.
cards.say: Can you buy an eight thousand rupiah toy with five thousand rupiah and two thousand rupiah? No. Together they make seven thousand rupiah, which is one thousand rupiah short.

cards.front: Rp100.000 take away Rp50.000
cards.say: One hundred thousand rupiah take away fifty thousand rupiah equals fifty thousand rupiah.
